description: Grafana mute timings referenced by notification_settings.mute_time_intervals in alerts/*.json. The --mode import path (verify_pusher_live_alert_route.py, run by gcp_cloud_run_metrics_egress.yml) creates each referenced timing on the target Grafana when it is absent; an existing live timing is never overwritten. omi-tier-silent is the always-on interval that mutes agent-tier rules (#23590); it has existed in prod Grafana since 2026-10-25 but development Grafana never received it, so the first dev import after #23590 failed with HTTP 500 and froze pusher dev qualification from run 40192461076.
